excerpts.content:
Not EEST 2.0.0, but I've just ran passing local runs of besu, revm, nethermind, and geth against EEST `main` fixtures generated by evmone.
 besu - branch `main`
 revm - branch `release_50`
 nethermind - branch `feature/evm/eof`
 geth - my repo (github shemnon/go-ethereum) branch `eof/extcodecopy-oob`
 evmone - branch `master`
